en_title: A Live-Action Cyberpunk 2077 Movie Is in the Works at Paramount
subtitle: 夜之城走向大银幕
opus_summary: 派拉蒙正在开发《赛博朋克2077》真人电影，CDPR也将参与制片。目前尚未公布演员、编剧及导演人选，也不清楚影片将直接改编游戏，还是讲述同一宇宙中的新故事。

paragraphs.en: Paramount Pictures is developing a live-action Cyberpunk 2077 film.
paragraphs.cn: 派拉蒙影业正在开发《赛博朋克2077》真人电影。

paragraphs.en: Deadline has reported that the film will be produced by Lorenzo di Bonaventura, who is best known for producing the Transformers and GI Joe films. CD Projekt Red is also onboard to produce, though there is no word on any actors, writers, or directors attached to the project. It's unclear if it will faithfully adapt the titular video game from 2020, or if this will be another story set in the Cyberpunk universe, similar to Netflix's animated Edgerunners series.
paragraphs.cn: 据Deadline报道，影片将由Lorenzo di Bonaventura担任制片人，他最为人熟知的制片作品是《变形金刚》和《特种部队》系列电影。CDPR也将参与制片，不过目前尚无消息透露哪些演员、编剧或导演将参与该项目。目前还不清楚，影片会忠实改编2020年推出的同名游戏，还是像Netflix动画剧集《赛博朋克：边缘行者》那样，讲述赛博朋克宇宙中的另一段故事。

paragraphs.en: If this is a straight up adaptation, Paramount already has some built-in starpower that it can utilize. In the game, Keanu Reeves played Johnny Silverhand, a radical Tyler Durden-style character that lives in the protagonist's head. Idris Elba also joined the game's cast in an expansion known as Phantom Liberty, which feels like a really cool storyline to adapt, though it may not work as well as a mainstream entry point into that universe. Either way, it's exciting to hear that Night City is making its way to the big screen.
paragraphs.cn: 如果影片直接改编游戏，派拉蒙已经有现成的明星阵容可以借力。游戏中，基努·里维斯饰演强尼·银手，这个激进角色风格类似泰勒·德顿，存在于主角的脑海中。伊德瑞斯·艾尔巴也在资料片《往日之影》中加入了游戏的演员阵容。这段故事感觉很适合改编，应该会很酷，不过用它来引导大众观众认识这个宇宙，效果可能没那么好。无论如何，得知夜之城将登上大银幕，还是让人兴奋。

paragraphs.en: CD Projekt Red is also hard at work on the next Cyberpunk game , which is expected to release after The Witcher 4. As a result, we may not see the next game until 2029 or 2030 at the absolute earliest. But that may also be perfect timing, as a Cyberpunk film may not be ready until around that time either. Reeves has already expressed interest in appearing in the next Cyberpunk game , so maybe he'd play Johnny Silverhand on the big screen too.
paragraphs.cn: CDPR也正在全力开发下一部《赛博朋克》游戏，预计将在《巫师4》之后发售。因此，我们可能最早也要等到2029年或2030年才能玩到这部新作。不过，这个时间或许恰到好处，因为《赛博朋克》电影可能也要到那时才能完成。里维斯已经表示有兴趣参演下一部《赛博朋克》游戏，所以他或许也会在大银幕上饰演强尼·银手。

paragraphs.en: Paramount is leaning heavy into major video game adaptations, as it has Street Fighter releasing next weekend. In 2028, the studio will also release a Call of Duty movie written by Taylor Sheridan and directed by Peter Berg. Paramount is making all kinds of big moves, as it just merged with Warner Brothers , meaning it has a wealth of new IP to take advantage of.
paragraphs.cn: 派拉蒙正大力投入热门游戏改编电影，旗下的《街头霸王》将于下周末上映。2028年，派拉蒙还将推出由泰勒·谢里丹编剧、彼得·博格执导的《使命召唤》电影。派拉蒙近期大动作不断，刚刚与华纳兄弟合并，也因此拥有了大量可供利用的新IP。
